name: Snippets
tagline: Text and code to paste again

offers.label: New snippet
offers.description: Makes a snippet, filed under `folder` when it names one.

offers.label: Rename folder
offers.description: Renames a folder everywhere it is used; an empty new name files its snippets under nothing.

offers.label: Rename tag
offers.description: Renames a tag everywhere it is used.

offers.label: Remove tag
offers.description: Takes a tag off every snippet that carries it.
